scope: Offline structural acceptance; semantic design inspection, not product execution or security certification.

results.initial: 17/19; two fixture mistakes: removed required trace evidence; corrected to package.json

semantic_design_inspection.method: Read requirements R01-R08, threat model, ADR 0003 and trace-review; compare roles and stated gaps. These are documented design associations, not tested product behavior.
semantic_design_inspection.R01: I01 covers scoped join/commit; concurrent edits lack a dedicated interaction.
semantic_design_inspection.R02: I03 covers forged write; authorized observation/updates lack a dedicated interaction.
semantic_design_inspection.R03: I01 and I02 cover scoped join and foreign selection.
semantic_design_inspection.R04: I02/I03/I04/I05/I11/I13/I15 cover selected authority and release cases; storage unavailability and lock-before-write lack dedicated interactions.
semantic_design_inspection.R05: I05-I09 and I14 cover receipt, recovery and interruption cases; missing disaster evidence not proving non-commit lacks standalone interaction.
semantic_design_inspection.R06: I06/I11/I12 cover interruption, policy/time and configuration; storage unavailability, safe logging and disaster evidence lack dedicated interactions.
semantic_design_inspection.R07: No canonical interaction for full release matrix; release remains unproven.
semantic_design_inspection.R08: No canonical interaction or measurements for operational objectives.

defect_history: 9d4 and 7b semantic mappings were incomplete; f6c repaired trace semantics; three fresh reviews were reported clear on the repaired implementation. This acceptance does not independently reproduce those historical reviews. Initial harness fixture errors are recorded in raw results.
platform_limits: Database, Discord and GoDaddy VPS are not applicable to offline repository tooling; actual application, security, platform and operational verification remain open.
follow_through: Root owns independent final review, native CI, protected merge, post-merge verification, issue 30 closure and issue 31 PR creation. Native post-merge/root closure remain pending.

owned_decisions.decision: Use in-process gate calls against immutable copied source and actual pinned first-install base, with disposable independently hashed mutations.
owned_decisions.rationale: Exercises offline fixed contract without Git, child processes, network, installation or source writes.
owned_decisions.validation: 19 cases passed; semantic inspection and gaps recorded separately.
owned_decisions.follow_through: Root integrates and independently reviews; runtime requirements remain open.
